messages:
tara: heads-up — last 6 weeks we keep seeing Dedicated warmup regressions. I ran a light analysis and grouped recurring signatures + a proposed sprint plan to close the loop. want quick owners and any gaps. :wave:

omar: paste the grouped signatures and one sample log?

tara: signatures:
- modprobe/udev timeout during GPU init -> warmup abort
- driver/firmware mismatch -> kernel oops/reboot loop
- orchestrator eviction while shard downloads (race)

sample log:
```
[2026-03-25T09:14:07Z] warmup: requesting shard 0/12
[2026-03-25T09:14:09Z] error: modprobe nvidia_uvm failed (exit 127)
[2026-03-25T09:14:10Z] node-controller: pod warmup timed out -> evict
```

li: that aligns with vendor rollouts we saw around 2026-02-27 and 2026-03-18. seems correlated.

dave: ok. short term (48h) proposal:
- omar: targeted rollback for pools with kernel oops (owner: omar) — due 2026-03-27 EOD
- li: add 1 retry + extended timeout to modprobe step behind FF (owner: li) — due 2026-03-27 noon
- tara: temp routing weight away from pools with >2 failures (owner: tara) — due 2026-03-27 EOD

longer term (2-4 weeks):
- infra: enforce firmware/AMI pin + rollout gating for Dedicated (owner: omar + infra) — due 2026-04-15
- runtime: autoscaler lease to protect warmup pods (owner: dave) — due 2026-04-05
- obs: "warmup-recurrence" dashboard + weekly recurrence alert (owner: tara) — due 2026-03-31
- process: add recurrence_count and hypothesis_tag fields to postmortem template (owner: omaressa) — due 2026-04-05

sre-bot: [ALERT] 1960000451 warmup_recurrence_spike detected for pool:redwood-dedicated-eu-01 (4 failures in 24h)

omar: creating rollback ticket now, will include verification steps and smoke test steps.

li: implementing retry PR in staging, behind FF. will report metrics from canary.

dave: I'll draft autoscaler lease design and post for review. small PR first, then ramp.

tara: I'll assemble a short sprint ticket TKT-7100 linking historical incidents and proposed owners. please add subtasks for runbooks + verification.

sre-bot: [INFO] TKT-7100 created and assigned to tara; priority: P1

omar: rollback scheduled for 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC. ETA 2h. will update here.

[~2h later]

omar: rollback complete on targeted hosts. warmup success on those nodes improved 70% -> 96% over 60m. logs attached to TKT-7100.

li: canary with retry shows drop in modprobe transient fails; monitoring for 48h.

dave: posted autoscaler lease design doc in the PR description; requesting eng-runtime review.

tara: next steps: owners update TKT-7100 with runbooks, add recurrence fields, and set expected close dates. we will review recurrence metrics in 2 weeks and either close or escalate to a reliability epic. thanks all. :+1:
